描述_EN: the tumbling elephant is part of a tumbling furniture set, based on simple geometric shapes cut to form bright and fun animal shaped furniture that appeal to children. it combines the practical function of seating with the creativity of play. the tumbling animals designed by danish company bobles can be used as a seat as well as in an inverse position a rocker or to scrabble over and under.
描述_ZN: 翻滚的大象是翻滚家具套装的一部分，基于简单的几何形状，切割成明亮而有趣的动物形状的家具，吸引儿童。 它结合了座椅的实用功能和游戏的创造性。 由丹麦公司Bobles设计的翻滚的动物可以作为一个座位，也可以在一个相反的位置作为一个摇椅或在上面和下面争夺。
